source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

hinge.title: Decide how to scale every term in a multi-term ratio when one corresponding quantity is fixed.
node_labels: Number: magnitude, representation and arithmetic structure

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Corresponding terms is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Decide how to scale every term in a multi-term ratio when one' is answered as corresponding terms rather than multi-term ratio.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Corresponding terms is what produces multi-term ratio, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Decide how to scale every term in a multi-term ratio.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The answer is multi-term ratio because of the most obvious label, colour, size or printed number in the stem, without using 'Decide how to scale every term in a multi-term ratio when one' as the operative test.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: multi-term ratio is settled by running 'Decide how to solve an inverse-proportion problem using the constant': If x and y are inversely proportional, then x1 * y1 = x2 * y2 = k; the missing value is — on the item about Decide how to scale every term in a multi-term ratio.

intelligence.enrichment: For proportional multi-term ratios, every corresponding term changes by the same factor; in a:b:c:d::p:q:r:s, a/p = b/q = c/r = d/s.
